"Generic Gamepad Template" by nicefrog, from OpenGameArt.org
https://opengameart.org/content/generic-gamepad-template
License: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). No attribution is required; it is given here anyway.

controller.svg / controller.png are the files as published. tools_pc/gen_menupad.py turns the PNG into a
greyscale line mask (port/src/menu/menu_pad.cpp) that the options menu draws behind the layout labels.
